Shashi Tharoor has sharply criticized the central government for imposing broad restrictions on public gatherings in Delhi, labeling them excessive measures during what he describes as an emergency-like situation. The opposition leader emphasized that such curbs disproportionately affect peaceful demonstrations and civil liberties.

In parallel, the detention of Central Justice of India leaders has drawn further scrutiny, with Tharoor calling for an end to arbitrary arrests and urging the judiciary to uphold constitutional protections for dissenting voices.
